03  Business of Connections — Partnership 2027
Our 2027 Conferences

Two specialist conferences. One European network.

Business of Class Actions Europe
Porto  |  19 February 2027

A one-day European conference focused on how collective actions work in practice. The programme will examine significant cross-border cases, qualified entities, settlements, economic evidence, litigation funding and emerging risks for companies.

Expected audience: 60–80 participants
Business of Competition
Prague  |  April 2027

A two-day conference bringing together competition practitioners, economists, regulators, businesses and litigation funders for practical discussions of enforcement, private litigation, digital markets and their impact on business.

Expected audience: 80–100 participants
Who You Will Meet
01

Corporate Legal Leaders

General Counsel, Heads of Litigation, Legal Directors, and in-house competition, regulatory and dispute-resolution specialists.

02

Leading Practitioners

Partners and counsel from claimant and defence law firms working on competition disputes, collective actions and complex cross-border litigation.

03

Litigation and Economic Experts

Litigation funders, economists, claims specialists, insurers and other professionals involved in assessing and managing cases.

04

Institutions and Associations

Competition authorities, qualified entities, consumer and trade associations, academics and selected policy experts.
